decision_conditions: Sufficient information has been provided to demonstrate compliance with the above stated conditions 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 11, 14 and 15 of planning permission number 24/01397/FUL. In this regard, it is held that the submission complies with the adopted London Plan policies, the Development Management Document (2014) policies, Core Strategy (2010) policies, and the NPPF (2024). Accordingly, the conditions can be DISCHARGED.
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/01397/FUL: external finishing materials (3), SuDS verification report (4), energy performance certificate (6), reduced water consumption (7), construction management report (8), hard/soft landscaping (11), enclosure (14) and biodiversity enhancements (15) in respect of sub-division of site and erection of a 2-storey dwelling house to the side of number 251 Ladysmith Road.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
